items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Lockjaw told me about a -- he tells me -- well, Lockjaw was hip to him.

ctx.x: Bostic must have been pretty young, too.

He was young, yeah, he was around my age. He was aroung -- yeah, he and I about the same age. But boy, he was a virtuoso on that horn, man, I mean -- and actually, what he made it big on wasn't really his style. He was in Bird vein, he played like Bird. But a lot of people didn't know that and you know, he just played like 'Flamingo'-type things and that's what they wanted to hear and that's where he made his gold.
